title: Help UniqueBeing Get a New Laptop and Get Back to Building 💻
description:
Hi everyone 👋🏽

I’m raising funds to get a new or fairly used laptop so I can get back to building.

My laptop has been malfunctioning for a while, and after trying to figure out the problem, I discovered that the motherboard is damaged beyond repair.

For someone who builds software, experiments with new ideas, and spends most of their time creating things on the internet, losing access to a working laptop is a much bigger setback than I can easily explain.

I’ve been less active and unable to build at the pace I want because of this limitation.

Over the past few years, I’ve been exploring, learning, and building across different parts of the tech ecosystem. I’ve worked on decentralized applications, participated in hackathons, built Farcaster Mini Apps, and experimented with products that I hope can grow into something meaningful.

I’m still very interested in building. I still have ideas I want to bring to life. But right now, I need a working laptop to do that properly.

That’s why I’m starting this fundraiser.

My goal is to raise enough money to purchase a reliable new or fairly used laptop, potentially through eBay, depending on what I can afford.

It doesn’t have to be the latest MacBook or the most powerful machine available. I just need something reliable enough to develop software, test applications, participate in hackathons, and continue working on my projects.

If you’ve followed my journey, used something I’ve built, or simply believe in helping independent builders keep going, I’d appreciate your support.

You can contribute whatever you’re comfortable with. Every contribution brings me closer to getting back to work.

If you can’t contribute financially, sharing this campaign with someone who might be willing to help would also mean a lot.

I’m not giving up on building. I’m working to get past this setback and continue doing what I love.

Thank you for reading, supporting, and believing in independent builders. ❤️

Let’s get me back to building!

The bounty is specifically for UniqueBeing404, and only @uniquebeing404 can claim the bounty funds.
